text: old rotary telephone bell ringing loudly in an empty room, two rings
picking up an old telephone handset, plastic clack, then faint line static
long fingernails slowly scraping along a glass window, creepy squeal
electrical power failure, all lights and fridges shutting down at once with a deep clunk and fading hum
eerie close whisper behind the listener's ear, breathy, no words
security camera monitor switching channels, digital click and static burst
